bio: Located near La Mauricie National Park, on the shores of Lake Bellemare, this country inn surrounded by forest would not be out of place on a postcard. From inside the inviting dining room, decorated with recycled materials to create a rustic chalet atmosphere, the view of the lake is magnificent. Chef Samy Benabed crafts locavore yet open-minded cuisine: his aesthetically pleasing dishes feature everything from barbecued items and preserved foods inspired by time spent in Scandinavia (lacto-fermentation, dehydration, etc.) to Quebec spices and citrus fruits…it all comes together harmoniously. A case in point is the venison tartare with wasabi mayonnaise, lacto-fermented red currants, capers, kale and nori. Simple food and a small deli counter are available at Le Comptoir.
